title: helichrysum nepalense
intro: Helichrysum nepalense, commonly known as the "Dhupbe" or "Riddhi", is a flowering plant species within the sunflower family. It is known for its medicinal properties, which provide various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, acting as an antioxidant, and exhibiting antimicrobial and antifungal activities. The therapeutic actions of Helichrysum nepalense include promoting wound healing, reducing pain and swelling, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, such as dihydrofilifolin, and other compounds like flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
